latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Editor — Edit and Export Videos Free:

- Instantly edits and exports videos via AI: upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB.
- No learning curve: simply describe desired edits (trim pauses, transitions, etc.) and receive a processed MP4 in 1–2 minutes.
- Free usage with 100 credits auto-granted via anonymous token, no registration required.
- Seamless backend session management, auto-reconnect, and error handling for uninterrupted editing.
- Ideal for content creators and students needing fast, no-cost editing without pro software.
- Supports multiple file formats; returns clean, platform-ready video exports.
